svg.aria-label: Comic: robots shout across the network to discover each other; the lidar posts letters stamped best effort into /scan; the map's mailbox only accepts reliable, so letters pile up undelivered; the map robot waits with an empty mailbox and no error
svg.title: DDS discovery and QoS mismatch, as a comic
svg.text: Discovery: everyone shouts to find everyone.
Nothing arrives, and nothing tells you why.
